dedupe_keys.name: public health center of ukraine medical reporting aggregated statistical reporting forms of health care facilities 2008 to 2025 staff reports and yearly statistical indicator handbooks

description: The Public Health Center of Ukraine publishes the country's aggregated medical statistical reporting, the forms that every health care facility files each year with the Ministry of Health. Yearly archives from 2008 to 2025 contain the aggregated forms for communal and ministry facilities and, separately, for all facilities including other ministries and private providers, such as form N-17 on medical staff. Handbooks of statistical indicators for 2014 to 2025 summarise the reported indicators for each year, and further analyses cover blood services, sanatoria, laboratories, child health and mortality. Coverage is national, limited since 2022 to facilities on government-controlled territory. The files are free and available to download as ZIP or RAR archives of spreadsheets and are classed as public data. Caveats: coverage changes with the war and territorial control, forms and aggregation levels differ between years, and archives need unpacking and translation from Ukrainian. Simulation uses: estimating hospital and workforce capacity by oblast, tracking the loss of health care capacity under attack, and planning service continuity and patient transfers. Related records: the WHO surveillance system for attacks on health care (data-who-ssa-attacks-on-health-care) records damage to Ukrainian facilities, and the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give comparisons.
